source.title: Let's Play Team Fortress 2: A Good Time on Badwater
source.sourceKind: independent-gameplay; original recorder Let’s Play; no finished technical lesson
source.authorshipEvidence: Current source description describes the uploader returning to their own Badwater match and identifies their play dates, May7/15,2016. It is not a compilation of other explainers.

licenseEvidence.method: Fresh yt-dlp --skip-download --dump-single-json -f137 source-page extraction, checked this session; label/uploader/description match the existing preserved metadata.
licenseEvidence.licenseVersion: Not specified in extracted label; no unverified CC version asserted

source.policyScope: Valve permits game-content videos and ad-supported video sharing. This does not cover other people’s recordings/music, so the recorder CC-BY label is separately checked and no source audio is included.
source.descriptionCredit: Gameplay excerpt: “[bass]-The Black Knight — Let’s Play Team Fortress 2: A Good Time on Badwater” (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8AdmAC_VPrE), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution as labeled on the source page. Excerpt selected and annotated; original commentary/audio excluded. Team Fortress 2 game content: Valve; https://store.steampowered.com/video_policy?l=english
source.audioUse: none; downloaded stream137 is video-only; source commentary and music not acquired

keyObservations.observed: Death/respawn and brief spawn-room return; not a tunnel/cart explanation.

keyObservations.before: POV leaves spawn onto the rail route.
keyObservations.action: BLU players run toward the payload; cart is visible near the rock formation.
keyObservations.result: Both people and cart have visible travel through the same level; useful short context.

keyObservations.before: POV and Heavy are beside the rock face and rail line.
keyObservations.action: They approach/turn into the curved rock tunnel.
keyObservations.result: The same rail route leads into the enclosed corridor.

keyObservations.before: Camera is inside the rock tunnel and can see its rail path and walls.
keyObservations.action: Payload cart and BLU players share the tunnel; cart fills local24–27,32–37,40–44; POV looks along its side/through the corridor while Heavy moves nearby.
keyObservations.result: The cart/player group progresses to the tunnel exit with room beside the cart visible. This confirms the modern game phenomenon, not historical prototype geometry.

keyObservations.before: Payload and Heavy reach the exit/gate area.
keyObservations.action: POV changes position beside the cart and surrounding players.
keyObservations.result: The group emerges into the next outdoor region; source continues at native speed.

keyObservations.before: Cart is outside the tunnel near the wall/corner.
keyObservations.action: POV and teammates fight/move beside the cart through the next rail bends.
keyObservations.result: Useful confirmation that the supported action is escorting/fighting beside the cart, beyond merely fitting the cart itself.

keyObservations.observed: Close player/model overlap and visual obstruction at the tail; avoid as explanatory proof.

inspection.passingClaimLimit: Sampled images clearly show cart+avatars sharing and moving through the actual tunnel. Camera rotation and close player overlap make exact front-to-back passing trajectories ambiguous; do not invent a measured crossing or collider outline from this source. Any per-player tracked annotation needs final native-speed cut review.

editRecommendations.provisionalRangeMeaning: An upper candidate budget, not a claim that every second is finally selected or that every frame shows the cart. Use speech-matched target/action/result; trim obstructions and unrelated combat.
editRecommendations.ratioStatus: Not measured/fulfilled. This adds genuine relevant coverage to the existing short outdoor-cart cut, but final60:40 requires actual narration duration and the final selected cut list. No loops, slowdown or unrelated padding authorized.
annotationTargets: actual tunnel walls and adjacent walking space
visible BLU Heavy/Medic at the same time as the cart
editRecommendations.annotationLimits: Editorial target guides only; no fabricated in-game dimensions, collision capsules, detector scores or original prototype before/after. Clear guides at cuts and occlusion; reserve fixed captions and cat.
editRecommendations.sourceFpsLimit: Native source30fps, not genuine60fps. Preserve native motion; a60fps delivery timeline does not add source temporal detail.
editRecommendations.historicalLimit: This2016 recording demonstrates the finished game. It is not footage of the original narrow prototype or evidence of the exact amount by which Valve widened the tunnel.
